Boende.md:
Exchange students can apply to stay in the SUTD hostel in on-campus housing, but this is not guaranteed and based on a ballot system.

**On-Campus Accommodation**

Typically, a single, non-ensuite room will be assigned to successful applicants, though other room types might be available. SUTD will inform nominated students of procedures via email when the portal is open for application.

[More information On-Campus housing](https://www.sutd.edu.sg/Campus-Life/Housing/Non-graduating)

**Off-Campus Accommodation**

Due to limited housing spaces in SUTD Hostel, it is highly advisable for exchange students to look for off-campus accommodation. SUTD will provide a list of off-campus accommodation options during application for exchange students to consider.

[More information Off-Campus housing](https://www.sutd.edu.sg/Campus-Life/Housing/Off-campus-Accommodation)

Om universitetet.md:
The UPV/EHU is located on three campuses:

**Biscay Campus** is the UPV/EHU’s biggest with 9 faculties. Engineering and Economics are located in **central Bilbao** , while the other faculties are located in the Leioa University complex (15 km from the city and well connected by local bus).

Bilbao is the biggest city in the Basque Country and is 11 km inland from the Gulf of Biscay. It is the financial capital of the region and has around 370,000 inhabitants. The Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao gave rise to a new beginning for a formerly industrial city. People in Bilbao are friendly, optimistic and good-tempered; the vibrant cultural life of the city turns, at dusk, into a varied, pepped nightlife.

**Gipuzkoa Campus** also has 9 faculties. The majority are located in **Donostia/San Sebastian** and another two Engineering sections in Eibar and Elgoibar.

Donostia/San Sebastian is the capital with a population of over 180.000 inhabitants. It stretches around the ‘Concha’ bay and is a popular tourist destination. Donostia/San Sebastián has become well-known for its surfing and coastal water sports. The city is 20 km from the French border. In addition to its natural beauty and belle epoch architecture, the city enjoys a busy cultural life (International Film Festival, Jazz Festival…) and countless local festivities throughout the year. Cuisine is a cornerstone of Basque culture and this city is famous for its tapas bars, called ‘pintxos’ here, and its Michelin-starred restaurants.

**Alava Campus** hosts 7 faculties centrally located in **Vitoria-Gasteiz** . The city has over 240,000 inhabitants. Its vast green areas and the low carbon footprint of locals helped make Vitoria-Gasteiz the European Green Capital in 2012 and the recipient of the Global Green City Award in 2019. Outdoor sports enthusiasts will appreciate how the city extends directly out to trekking trails, mountain bike routes, and water sports options in the surrounding rural landscape. Above the streets of the medieval old town looms the Santa Maria cathedral, which has undergone an impressive restoration and was the main inspiration for Ken Follett’s novel ‘A World Without End’. Throughout the year, the cultural calendar is filled with local festivities such as ‘La Virgen Blanca’, a medieval festival, and the Azkena Rock festival.

Språkkrav.md:
**The University of the Basque Country requires students to be proficient in Spanish as courses taught in English are very limited and full-time studies (30 ECTS) in English cannot be guaranteed. Students who do not speak Spanish cannot apply to this university.**

**NOTE! You must provide proof of Spanish language proficiency at the time of application to Uppsala University** (15 November / 15 May **).**

**A minimum level of B1 (CEFR) is required, though B2 or higher is strongly recommended. Applications without a valid Spanish test result or other proof of Spanish language proficiency will not be considered for this exchange.**

An official Spanish proficiency certificate may also be required depending on the faculty. This information should be available on the university’s website under the relevant faculty section. If no such requirement is mentioned, no certificate is likely needed. If a Spanish proficiency certificate is required, theBasque Country will inform you of the timeline.

Om universitetet.md: The University of Bern (German: Universität Bern, French: Université de Berne, Latin: Universitas Bernensis) is a public research university in the Swiss capital of Bern. It was founded in 1834 with roots going back to the 16th century. It is a comprehensive university offering a broad choice of courses and programs in eight faculties and some 150 institutes. With around 19,000 students, the University of Bern is the third largest university in Switzerland. It does not have a single large campus on the edge of the city but has consistently pursued the principle of a university in the city. Most institutes and clinics are still in the “Länggasse”, the traditional university district adjoining the city centre, within walking distance of one another.

Om universitetet.md:
**Founded:** 1928

**Student Body:** 34 000

**Faculties/Colleges:** 17 colleges, 61 departments and 152 graduate institutes

**Interesting Fact:** NTU's institutional predecessor was Taihoku Imperial University, founded by the Japanese colonial administration. After World War II and Taiwan's retrocession to Chinese Sovereignty, the R.O.C. government completed the taking-over officially on November 15, 1945, with Dr. Tsung-lo Lo serving as the first president, and reorganised and renamed the school "National Taiwan University".

The University also boasts a number of international and national research centers, as well as university-level research centers.

Om universitetet.md:
Makerere University is Uganda's largest and oldest University, first established as a technical school in 1922. In 1963, it became the University of East Africa, offering courses leading to general degrees from the University of London. It became an independent national university in 1970 when the University of East Africa was split into three independent universities: University of Nairobi (Kenya), University of Dar es Salaam (Tanzania), and Makerere University. Today, Makerere University is composed of nine colleges and one school offering programmes for about 36,000 undergraduates and over 4,000 postgraduates. The Times Higher Education World University Rankings for 2016 ranked Makerere as the fourth best university in Africa.

Makerere University is a semi-autonomous and non-profit institution serving a multicultural and multinational student community. Makerere University is located on Makerere Hill, which is one of the many hills on which Kampala, the Capital City of Uganda, is built. The main Campus is about 5 km to the North of the City Centre covering an area of 300 acres. The location offers an excellent academic environment free from all forms of disturbances associated with city centre locations.

Om orten.md: Kampala is the capital and largest city of Uganda. The city is located in Southern/Central Uganda on the northern shores of Lake Victoria, the largest lake in Africa. The population is roughly 6 million. Kampala has a tropical rainforest climate. The weather features two annual wet seasons. There is a long rainy season from August to December and a short rainy season from February to June. The temperature ranges from 17°C to about 30°C, and rarely reaching 36°C during the hot dry seasons. Average humidity is 75%.

the famous Ukrainian writer, politician and activist Ivan Franko who studied at  
the university’s faculty of philosophy. It became a national  
university in 1999 and is now one of the oldest universities in Eastern Europe.

The  
university has a student population of approximately 20,000 students and comprises 17 faculties: biology, chemistry, journalism, economics,  
electronics, philology, philosophy, physics, geography, geology, history,  
foreign languages, culture and art, applied mathematics and informatics,  
mechanics and mathematics, law and international relations. It also includes  
three colleges, an Institute of Postgraduate Study and Pre-University Training.  
The faculty of economics is based in both Sambor and Chervonohrad. The mathematics  
departments are considered to be some of the best in Eastern Europe.

Om universitetet.md:
Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv (TSNUK) is a leading and one of the largest higher education institutions in Ukraine. It is comprised of eight institutes (Journalism, International Relations, Philology, High Technology, Military, Postgraduate Education, Biology, Geology) and 14 faculties (Geography, Economics, History, Cybernetics, Mathematics and Mechanics, Sociology, Radiophysics, Psychology, Physics, Philosophy, Chemistry, Law, Information Technology, and Faculty for International Students).

The University cooperates with over 280 higher education institutions and international organizations from 57 countries throughout the world. TSNUK as a powerful multi-branch scientific, research and training institution contributes to enhance the quality and training of its students, researchers and research facilities. The Internationalization aspects at the TSNUK include the introduction of the joint diploma programs for Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degrees and PhD, as well as to review and develop the curriculum in order to obtain double degrees in different study fields.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
Entry requirements:
- 2 years of prior study completed upon entry to UCL
- A minimum of 3.3/4.0 US GPA equivalent.

It is not possible for  
Postgraduate (MA) students to apply as Undergraduate (BA) students. This  
means that no students who have completed a bachelor degree can apply  
to UCL.  
Students attending an integrated bachelor and master degree  
program at Uppsala University may apply for undergraduate studies at  
UCL.

There are two student exchange agreements with UCL:

1. The exchange within SELCS is best suited to Humanities  
students who plan to study mainly within SELCS, as securing courses in  
other departments upon arrival can be difficult.  
The exchange within the School of European Languages, Culture and Society (SELCS) requires that at least 50% of your courses must be taken  
at SELCS; the  
remaining 50% may be taken in SELCS or in other UCL departments, subject to  
availability and prerequisites.

All subjects are available at bachelor level except e.g. Law, English, English Literature and Computer Science.

Economics: Only introductory courses (level1).

Management: Fall term modules are only available for students studying for the full year.

2. New! In the application round during Autumn 2026 students can for the first time apply for an exchange entirely within Law. You need to have a background as a Law student. This exchange is for a full year only, no single semesters.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
Courses are available within **College of Humanities and Social Science** on bachelor/undergraduate level with some exemptions.  
Courses within these subjects **are no** t available for Uppsala students:  
• Medicine  
• Veterinary Medicine  
• Studio-based Architecture, Art and Design classes  
• Education and Sport  
• Law

You may choose courses from year 1 and 2. More restrictive admission for courses on year 3 and 4. Honour-level courses require at least three completed courses within the specific subject with a B as the lowest grade. No guaranteed admission.

These following courses on year 3 and 4 are almost impossible to get: English literature, History, Politics and International Relations, Philosophy, History of Art.

If you would like to take courses within  
year 3 or 4, a language test result may be required. (A minimum of 6.5 (IELTS) or a minimum of 92 with at least 23 credits in every part of the test (TOEFL) may be required.  
The test can than be done in Edinburgh,  
but please observe that courses fill up quickly. If you want to take  
one of those courses, it is a good idea to do the test well in advance, but once again there is no guaranteed admission.

**It's not certain that it is possible to go to this university on an exchange after you have completed your studies.**

Språkkrav.md:
No English test results are required in the application rounds arranged by the Unit for International Mobility at Uppsala University in May and Nov, but you might need one later when you apply to Edinburgh, depending on what you are going to study and if your exchange will last for one or two semesters.

One semester:

If your exchange will last for one semester only and you are studying a programme entirely taught in English at Uppsala University, no English test results are needed, just a certificate regarding you studying this English taught programme.

If  
you do not need a Student Route visa and do not have the the language test certificates mentioned below, you will be required to demonstrate a level of C1 (CEFR)  
in English to access the 3rd and 4th year level courses in the College  
of Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences.  
High School Certificate from Swedish Gymnasium with A, B or C from Engelska 7 is approved, as long as it is not older than 3,5 years.

Two semesters  
In line with recent immigration changes, EU students who will be joining Edinburgh for a full academic year  
on a Student Route visa will be required to provide proof of English  
language proficiency through one of the accepted qualifications [listed on the website](https://www.ed.ac.uk/studying/undergraduate/entry-requirements/english-language).

Accepted tests are IELTS, TOEFL iBT, Trinity ISE, language Cert International ESOL, Cambridge CAE and CPE.

This[chart](https://www.ed.ac.uk/files/atoms/files/english_language_flow_chart.pdf)explains more of who does need an English language certificate or not.

Boende.md:
[Accommodation](https://global.ed.ac.uk/study-abroad/living-edinburgh/accommodation): Full year Erasmus students \*are guaranteed\* an offer of University Accommodation provided they submit an accommodation application by the deadline. Due to the demand for our accommodation, single semester Erasmus students \*are not\* guaranteed an offer of accommodation.  
These students are still encouraged to apply for accommodation; if any accommodation does become available, the Accommodation team will contact the student to make them aware. Students must have accepted an unconditional offer to study at the University of Edinburgh before they can apply for accommodation. There are many flats to rent on the private market.

Semester Only students

Students for a single semester are not guaranteed accommodation. However, we would advise that you still submit a university accommodation application in case there are spaces left.

Please do not rely on being allocated a spot in University accommodation. If there are no rooms available, you will need to look for private accommodation.

Finding semester only private accommodation in Edinburgh can be difficult, therefore students should be prepared to spend time researching their housing options.

[Private Housing](https://www.ed.ac.uk/global/study-abroad/living-edinburgh/)

Om universitetet.md:
The University of Sussex is a leading higher education and research institution near Brighton, in the south of England. Sussex was the first of the new wave of UK universities founded in the 1960s, receiving its Royal Charter in 1961. The University of Sussex has over 14,000 students, of which over a third are postgraduates. Creative thinking, pedagogic diversity, intellectual challenge and interdisciplinarity have always been fundamental to a Sussex education.  
Sussex has developed a reputation for innovation and inspiration, and attracts leading thinkers and researchers. They have over 2,100 staff, including around 1,000 teaching and research staff, of which, over 300 are research-only. They have counted three Nobel Prize winners, 14 Fellows of the Royal Society, 12 Fellows of the British Academy and a winner of the prestigious Crafoord Prize on their faculty. The University attracts staff and students to its campus from over 120 different countries across the world. Nearly a third of staff come from outside the UK.  
Their research tackles major world issues, with leading areas of expertise such as climate change and development studies. The University has extensive links with many institutions worldwide, such as Peking University, National Taiwan University and the Harvard-Sussex programme.

Visum och uppehållstillstånd.md:
Students are strongly advised to read the [Visa Guidance.](https://student.sussex.ac.uk/international/visas/applying)

**1. Standard visitor visa**  
Applies to students coming for one semester. How to apply for a standard visitor visa depends on the student’s nationality.  
Those classed as visa nationals must apply before arriving to Sussex. Those classed as non-visa nationals (incl. EU/EEA) do not have to apply for immigration clearance. They can enter the UK as visitors free of charge. Students might be asked to show certain documents at the border. Students will be required to show their Passports and Boarding Passes upon registration at Sussex as a proof of their clearance to study in the UK.

**2. Student visa route**  
Applies to students coming for the full academic year. It is important students read our visa guidance before applying to understand application cost, processes and documents required.

An Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) is required before entering the UK (from Spring 2025). For more information please read here: [https://www.gov.uk/guidance/apply-for-an-electronic-travel-authorisation-eta](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/apply-for-an-electronic-travel-authorisation-eta)

Om universitetet.md:
California State University (CSU) consists of 23 campuses with a total of 430,000 students. Each campus is basically an independent university with education in most subject areas. CSU is an ever-growing university. The oldest campus, San José, was founded in 1857, while the Channel Islands was established as late as 2002. The University is primarily focused on education at the undergraduate level.

More information about the CSU campuses can be found [here](https://csuip.calstate.edu/index.cfm?FuseAction=Abroad.ViewLink&Parent_ID=01E879DA-5056-BA1F-7216FE7D6C361227&Link_ID=84F08201-5056-BA1F-74FE8333996C9DE5).

California State University (CSU) should not be confused with the University of California system (UC) which is an entirely different University system but sometimes has campuses in the same city.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
**This exchange is open for:**  
Degree-seeking undergraduate or postgraduate students who wish to study at the undergraduate level. It includes onlystudies at  
the undergraduate level at one campus. No Master level / graduate level courses. As students have to bedegree-seeking students at Uppsala University during the entire duration of the exchange, it is not possible to go here on an exchange after you have graduated.

**This exchange is not open for:** U.S. citizens (by birth or after birth through parents or naturalization), U.S. permanent residents including those with U.S. dual citizenship.

Business Studies can only be studied at San Marcos (except for Accounting) and not at any other campus.  
Business  
at California State University includes: Marketing, Management, Human Resources, Accounting,  
International Business, Finance and Administration.Instead, you can take courses in: Economics  
/ Statistics.

No courses in Law Schools are open to exchange students. Instead, you can choose courses in: Criminal Justice / Political Science (pre-Law) / Business Administration (Business Law) and Philosophy (pre-Law).

Note that it is extremely difficult to be admitted to the California Maritime  
Academy.

**Please note that you must be flexible in which campus to study at. It is not possible for us to send several students to the same campuses, therefore be aware that San Diego, Long Beach and Los Angeles campuses are extremely hard to get and you need to be flexible.**

**NOTE: Proof of language proficiency (or proof of confirmation of scheduled test) is required with your application to Uppsala University for exchange studies!**

English test results (or proof of a scheduled English language test) REQUIRED at the time of application to Uppsala University for exchange studies (15 November/15 May) in order to be considered for California State University.

Applications without this will not be eligible for CSU. If you only provide a receipt/proof of a scheduled test, any offer for CSU will be conditional until your test results are submitted to the Mobility office.

Test results must not be older than two years prior to March 30 for fall term applicants and August 31 for January term applicants.

**Founded:** 1862  
**Student body:** 2,200 students  
**Interesting facts:** Gustavus Adolphus College (GAC) is a liberal arts college founded by Swedish descendants in 1862 and is named after Gustaf II Adolf.

There are very good chances to receive a generous scholarship to help with housing costs (on-campus housing) and a meal plan. TOEFL Total score of 80 or higher (no section score below 20)

IELTS Overall score of 6.5 or higher (no section score below 6.0)

DET (Duolingo English Test) including subscores. Overall 110 or better.

Scores must be no more than two years old at the time of admission.

**Students  
who receive an offer of a place in May/November and who do not submit an  
approved test result at the time of the application will receive a  
conditional offer of exchange place.** Last day to submit TOEFL for this  
university: week 6 - 3 February.

avtal.avtalsnamn: General university-wide exchange - University of Arizona - All fields of study

Om universitetet.md: The University of Arizona was founded in 1885 and has about 35,000 students in basically the same subject areas that are represented at Uppsala University, as well as architecture and agronomy. The University is one of America's premier research universities and is a world leader in astronomy and space research. It also has a Nobel laureate in physics, and is well known for its programs in economics, technology, anthropology and classical archaeology. Please note that courses in Computer Science as well as undergraduate courses at Eller Business College are not included in the exchange.

Om orten.md:
Tucson is located in southern Arizona, about 10 miles north of the border to Mexico, and was founded as a Spanish garrison in 1776. Today the city has about 1 million inhabitants and is due to its mild climate and almost 360 sunny days per year, a winter destination for many retirees.

The city is beautifully situated and surrounded by mountains and the lush Sonoran Desert, including candelabra cacti (saguaros) which can grow up to 20 meters. The University is located relatively central in the city. Besides good opportunities for nature walks in the desert, you will also find North America's southernmost ski slopes here. Grand Canyon as well as cities such as San Diego and Las Vegas are about seven hours away by car.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
**Undergraduate students only.**

Students must be in good academic and disciplinary standing at Uppsala University. **Students who will have received their degree by the time they come to UArizona are not eligible for exchange as undergraduate students.**  
Nominated students must be enrolled at their home institution as continuing degree-seeking students.

Exchange students are not allowed to conduct research.

**Business** : Undergraduate exchange students cannot take classes in any business department (including Accounting,  
Administration, Economics, Entrepreneurship, Finance, Management, Management Information Systems, or  
Marketing).  
The only exceptions to the business class policy are:  
• Students may register for Global Business courses, BNAD 449 (offered in Fall), BNAD 450 (offered in Spring), and  
BNAD 201 (offered in Fall)  
• Students can take BNAD 301, 302, and 303, however, these courses are almost always at capacity and priority  
goes to graduating seniors.

**Computer Science** : Students applying for exchange in Computer Science should be aware that course availability is  
limited and UArizona Computer Science Majors and Minors have priority. Further, Computer Science will allow  
enrollment in a maximum of three (3) CS classes; students should plan to take at least one class outside of the  
department to meet the required 12-credit minimum for exchange.

**Retail & Consumer Science:** Exchange students are not permitted to take courses in this program.

**Visual Communications:** Exchange students are not permitted to take courses in graphic design, illustration, or  
typography.

**Nursing:** Exchange students are not permitted to take Nursing courses.

Some programs may require a portfolio or an audition before advanced coursework can be taken (e.g. Fine Arts,  
Performing Arts, Media Arts, Music, Dance, and Architecture).

Must have at least Grade Point Average (GPA): 2.5

Om universitetet.md: The University of Colorado at Boulder, founded in 1876, is among the premier research universities in the US, especially in physics and chemistry. Several Nobel prizes have also been awarded professors at the university in these subject areas; one in chemistry in 1989 and two in Physics in 2001 and again in 2005. The university is also very highly regarded programs in economics and journalism, as well as many other subjects. CU is frequently found at the top in ranking lists for top universities in the world.

The university is also very highly regarded programs in economics and journalism, as well as many other subjects. Om orten.md: The University is located at the foot of the Rocky Mountains at the so-called Flatirons in the town of Boulder, approximately a half hour drive from Colorado's capital, Denver. Situated at around 1700 meters altitude are good opportunities for sports of all kinds, especially skiing and mountaineering. Boulder, which has about 90 000 inhabitants, has a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere and a pleasant climate with over 300 days of sunshine per year. The city has been rated by students as one of "the top ten college sites" in the United States. Students are offered free transport on local transportation and free admission to the "Recreation Center".

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
THE EXCHANGE AGREEMENT INCLUDES: Humanities, social sciences and natural sciences but not courses in Education, Music or Law. Students interested in taking upper division or graduate level classes will need specific permission from the department/instructor to join. However, they will be registered as undergraduate students and admittance to graduate courses is not guaranteed.

NOTE: Due to an  
enrollment restriction for the Department of Psychology at CU Boulder, the  
university cannot accept Psychology majors for the exchange program. While  
students might be able to enroll in entry-level Psychology courses, this is not  
guaranteed.

No restrictions apply to the Arts and Sciences and Engineering. Only students who have previous studies in Mass Media can take Journalism classes. Similarly, only students with Business Studies A (FEK A) can select Business courses. Find out more about what you can study, [https://www.colorado.edu/oie/student-exchanges/what-can-i-study](https://www.colorado.edu/oie/student-exchanges/what-can-i-study).

**Please observe that you can not study as an exchange student at this university after you have completed your studies.**

Om universitetet.md:
**Founded:** 1947  
**Student body:** About 3,000 students.

**Faculties/Colleges:** 6 colleges  
**Interesting facts:** University of Hawaii at Hilo is a public university and it's main strengths lie in the subjects of computer science, economics, astronomy and biology. The marine environment around the islands, the geological diversity and cultural wealth are widely used as sources of teaching. As of 2018, the campus is tobacco- and smoke-free.

Om orten.md: The coastal city of Hilo has about 45,000 inhabitants and is located on Hawaii's largest island, Hawaii, which then gave its name to the entire archipelago. It is also called the "Big Island". The island has many unique climate zones in a limited area, from the jungle and rain forest to alpine climate at the top of more than 4,000 meters of altitude on the volcanoes Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa peaks, which can be seen from the city center. The climate is tropical, the coast is around +27°C and the difference between summer and winter temperature is only a few degrees. The tropical climate also means a lot of precipitation. The city of Hilo is the US city that receives the most rainfall per year.

Om orten.md:
The

middle of the city of Urbana-Champaign, which is really two cities. The total  
population is approximately 100 000 inhabitants, and the cities are expanding  
rapidly, especially since Champaign has earned the reputation of being a  
cultural academics city. The university is the largest employer and also  
characterizes the two twin cities of Urbana and Champaign, that are surrounded  
by miles of corn, wheat, and bean fields.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
Students must have completed 1 year in residence at home university.

All students (undergraduate and graduate) will be processed as undergraduate at Illinois, no matter their level at their home university.

Please note that the exchange does not include Law, Medicine or courses at the College of Business.

**Closed  
programs:**
- College of Law, Masters of Science in Financial Engineering (MSFE), or  
Technology and Management (TMGT) courses. Engineering exchange students cannot take courses offered by Gies Business (BUS, BADM, FIN, ACCY),

**Limited programs:**
- Students  
assigned to Computer Science (CS) will be allowed to take 2 CS courses per  
semester and will be required to meet course pre-requisites. This means  
students will have taken the equivalent of Illinois CS 173 and CS 225 for acces  
to most CS courses, and CS 361 for students interested in Machine Learning  
courses.
- Students  
assigned to Physics will be allowed to take a maximum of 3 PHYS courses per  
semester.

**Other course information:**
- All engineering  
exchange students are required to take ENG 398 Grainger Engineering Design Your  
Experience.
- There is no  
guarantee of course enrollment in any specific course. Students are encouraged to be flexibile in course selection.

Kurskatalog.md:
Exchange  
students can find available courses in the [Course  
Catalogue](https://catalog.illinois.edu/) and [Course Explorer](https://courses.illinois.edu/).

**Courses are divided  
into levels:**

100–299:  
Lower division (introductory level)

300–499:  
Upper division (advanced level)

While  
you may enroll in upper-division courses, you are strongly  
discouraged from taking more than three courses at the 300 level or above per  
semester.

In  
addition, it is not recommended to take more than three  
courses within your major field, particularly in  
Engineering and the Sciences.

**Please note:**
- Undergraduate students may enroll in courses at the 100–400 level only.
- Courses at the 500 level or above require  
special permission, which is not guaranteed.

**Course Selection for your application:**

When applying,  
please base your course selection on previous offerings:  
Fall semester applicants: Select courses offered during the previous Fall semester.  
Spring semester applicants: Select courses offered during the previous Spring semester.

Språkkrav.md:
Recognized English language test is required.
- TOEFL iBT: minimum score 100
- IELTS: at least 7 on all modules
- Duolingo: minimum score 130

College of Engineering: TOEFL  
iBT 100 / IELST 6.5.

Other colleges may require higher scores - please check: [https://www.studyabroad.illinois.edu/incoming-students/incoming-application-process/instructions-components/index.html](https://www.studyabroad.illinois.edu/incoming-students/incoming-application-process/instructions-components/index.html)

**Students who are  
offered a place but have not submitted an approved language test at the time of  
application will receive a conditional offer.**

The final deadline  
to submit a language test result for this university is 10 August 2026. Students are strongly encouraged to complete the test before exchange  
places are allocated in the spring application round.

Boende.md:
Upon  
acceptance, students may apply for a room in a university residence hall (most  
residence halls require students to purchase a meal plan). Due  
to an increase in new freshman and transfer degree-seeking students at  
Illinois, exchange students who apply for University Housing may be placed on a  
waitlist and there is no guarantee that they will receive a University Housing  
room assignment. Students  
who apply for university housing are entering a contract with the University  
Housing office and there are penalties for cancelling the contract.

Exchange students can apply to on-campus Private Certified  
Housing or rent a private apartment.
- [On-campus housing](https://www.housing.illinois.edu/)
- [Off-campus housing](https://occl.illinois.edu/)

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
The exchange  
agreement covers most academic fields at the **graduate level** . However, some  
restrictions apply in the areas of Business, Management, Communication,  
Clinical Psychology, and Linguistics. For detailed information, students are  
advised to contact the UMass International Exchange Student Advisor.

Students from Uppsala University are not eligible to participate in the **Engineering Management** program. In addition, course availability within the **Isenberg School of Business** and the **Department of Computer Science** is very limited.

Please note that the  
number of exchange places is limited across many departments at UMass.  
Admission procedures may vary: some departments review applications on a  
first-come, first-served basis, while others apply specific selection criteria.

Exchange students  
may be eligible to enroll in courses outside their primary field of study,  
provided they meet the course requirements and have completed the necessary  
prerequisites (such as relevant prior coursework).

**Important** : Exchange  
opportunities at UMass are available to graduate-level students only.

Om universitetet.md:
The University of Michigan (UM) at Ann Arbor is a typical American research-oriented university with about 36,000 students and around 16,000 employees.

The University of Michigan School of Information (UMSI) prepares students to be leaders in a wide variety of information-related careers.  
Incoming exchange, or mobility, students at UMSI will find an unmatched combination of excellence and opportunities in information science; faculty with national and international reputations for excellence in teaching and research; impressive facilities for every academic endeavor; and a safe place to live and learn in one of the best college towns in the United States of America. UMSI is one of the world’s premier iSchools.

Om universitetet.md:
**Founded:** 1876  
**Student Body:** 24,000 (3,000 international)

**Faculties/Colleges:** 9 Colleges and Schools

**Networks/Collaborations:** Member of the Association of Pacific Rim Universities (APRU) and the Association of American Universities (AAU).

**Interesting Facts:** The University of Oregon is one of the most famous universities in the United States. The 280-acre campus in Eugene is an official arboretum, containing over 500 species of tress. The university mascot is the Oregon Duck, based on Disney's character through a special license agreement, and students attending UO are known as "Ducks".

Om orten.md: The city of Eugene, with approximately 200,000 inhabitants, is located about an hour's drive from the sea and an impressive coast. The surroundings offer excellent opportunities for sports and outdoor activities of all kinds, including skiing since the city is located in a valley surrounded by mountains. In Eugene, there are also good opportunities for various cultural events and the town has a safe and relaxed atmosphere. In addition to housing costs, Eugene is a relatively cheap city to live in, partly because food and other goods are exempt from VAT in Oregon. The slightly larger city of Portland is located about 100 miles north of Eugene and the climate is mild with quite a lot of precipitation.

Poängomräkning.md:
1 credit = 1.33 hp and 45 credits = 60 hp

University of Oregon (UO) uses quarter system where 3 quarters = 1 academic year.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
The exchange agreement includes all subject areas.

Please note that exchange students must be flexible when selecting course, as admission might be slightly restricted during the fall semester.
- Some courses have pre-requisite requirements which will be noted on the course page. You need to be able to demonstrate that you have sufficient academic background to be successful in courses with prerequisites.
- Some courses are restricted to students in a specific major.
- Exchange students are not eligible to take **graduate-level** courses in the **School of Law** or the **College of Business**
- Graduate-level business students are not eligible to take undergraduate coursework in the College of Business

Om universitetet.md: University of Richmond, founded in 1830, is a small private university with about 3,000 students. The university offers education primarily in the humanities and social sciences, and to some extent within the natural sciences. There is also a law school and a school for leadership training. The university is known primarily for it's education in business administration. It is considered one of America's most beautiful campuses and has a unified architecture as a proprietary brand. The University is very concerned about the students and each student gets their own academic adviser.

As in most other American cities, the car is the preferred mode of transport.

Several Nobel Prize winners have been and are still active at the University, which belongs to one of the foremost and wealthiest public universities in the United States. The University is prominent in a number of disciplines, including pharmacy, economics, physics and computer science (the latter subject, however, not included in the exchange). The university is, in addition to the research, also known for a wide range of sports and other leisure activities.

The following programs are not open to exchange:

-Dell Medical School: Closed to exchange students. UT can accept medical students to other related majors such as Biology or Neurosciences.

-Option III Programs (customized fee-paying graduate level programs that are not available under reciprocal exchange agreements).

-School of Information (iSchool): There is no undergraduate major. Students who are interested in taking classes should apply with another major.

Master students at UU can apply to this exchange, but will be registered at UT as undergraduates. In this case graduate/master-level courses are possible but not guaranteed at the time of the application. Om orten.md: Seattle, which has about 600,000 inhabitants, is beautifully located on the US west coast near the Canada border. Around a third of the population is of Asian origin, and many Swedish descendants also live there. Seattle is a pleasant and safe city to live in and has a rich cultural life with many entertainment options. The city also offers good opportunities for various outdoor activities such as skiing, hiking, rafting, rock climbing and boating. From the city's most famous buildings, the Space Needle, there is a magnificent view of the mountains (Mount Rainier) and sea. The Seattle area has a mild and precipitation-rich climate. The University is situated approximately 15 minutes from the city center by bus in a very beautiful campus.

subjects: Business, Art/Design (and other studio courses), Architecture, Communications,  
Computer Science, Economics, Engineering (all branches), Finance, Math, Law,

students, nor is the Information School.

Ämnesbegränsningar.md:
Study restrictions: Choose courses from Engineering or computer science
- Students must take 70% of their courses in the department they are nominated to (1-2 electives from another department). Exceptions can be made for students studying in programs that combine two departments. However, this can cause timetabling issues.
- To increase the options of courses available, the School of Computer Science now allows 3rd year BSc students (completed 120 ECTS) to take MSc-level courses.
- Exchange students cannot take courses offered by Iceland School of Energy (except ISE partners) MBA & Clinical Psychology.
- Iceland School of Energy: It's not possible to nominate students to ISE unless there is a specific agreement in place. Exchange students from partner universities of ISE are **only allowed to take one semester** in the programme.
- Students are only accepted for thesis work if pre-arranged with a Professor.

It's not possible to do a degree project during the exchange in Galway.

Kurskatalog.md:
If you plan on taking courses you should apply for the [ACAP programme](https://www.titech.ac.jp/english/international-student-exchange/prospective-students/non-degree/acap). [Here you can find a list of available courses](https://www.titech.ac.jp/english/international-student-exchange/prospective-students/non-degree/course-information).

The syllabus for courses is available [here](https://www.ocw.titech.ac.jp/index.php?lang=EN).

**Course Information for International Exchange Students**

ACAP participants are mandated to take 6 classes (600 minutes) or more per week to maintain student visa status. All participants are assigned to one of Science Tokyo’s Schools or Departments. In principle, they should plan their course of study mainly around courses offered in the Department to which they are assigned. However, not all courses offered at Science Tokyo are available for International Exchange Students. Final-year undergraduate students should refer to previously approved 400-level courses and carefully consider the courses they can take while studying abroad at Science Tokyo. Please refer to the enclosed document “Science Tokyo Course Information to Help Develop Your Study Plan.
- Course Numbers and Indicated Levels; 100-level, 200-level, 300-level: Undergraduate Level / 400-level, 500-level: Master's Level / 600-level: PhD Level
- Any courses conducted in English in the 100 and 200 levels cannot be taken.
- There are not many 300-level courses available in English. If you are an undergraduate

student not in the final year in ACAP and wish to take courses in English because of your

Japanese proficiency, please carefully draw up a study plan in advance that will allow you

to complete the program despite only taking 300-level courses taught in English.
- Students may take Japanese language courses at any level and are not allowed to take language classes other than Japanese.

If you want to do a project you should apply for the [YSEP programme.](https://www.titech.ac.jp/english/international-student-exchange/prospective-students/non-degree/ysep)

Boende.md:
**Housing:**

For students who have submitted a request to move into a Science Tokyo dormitory through the online application, the Global Education Division from October 1, 2024 will request that the department in charge of university dormitories will allocate a room for them. (Students are not required to apply for dormitories individually.) Students will be notified by email 1 to 1.5 months prior to enrollment

whether or not they will be able to move into the dormitory. In that case, please follow the instructions in the email. We do not accept changes of dormitories assigned to applicants.

Note that not all incoming students will be assigned a dormitory room as room availability is limited.

Vaccinationer och hälsa.md:
Additional required documents before enrollment:

・ Health Certificate for Infectious Diseases

International students who have passed the entrance exam and whose registered enrollment period will be three months or longer are required to have the health certificate completed and signed by a physician within the three-month period before the designated date of enrollment at Science Tokyo (or within the three-month period before their planned date of arrival in Japan if their arrival will be later than the date of entrance). In addition, we request that it be submitted prior to the designated date of entrance (or prior to arriving in Japan if the arrival will be later than the date of entrance).

Note that all expenses for this shall be borne by students.

Please cooperate with our preventive measures against various infectious diseases that could cross international borders in order to protect the health and wellbeing of you and your colleagues.

For more details, please refer to the following website;

[https://www.titech.ac.jp/english/student-support/prospective-students/admitted/international-infection](https://www.titech.ac.jp/english/student-support/prospective-students/admitted/international-infection)

Visum och uppehållstillstånd.md:
International students at Japanese universities are required to obtain a "student"  
visa. Obtaining "student" visa status is essential in order to apply for various kinds  
of assistance and scholarships for international students.

1) After the application, the staff of the Global Education Division apply for the  
student's COE (Certificate of Eligibility), which is documentation used for obtaining  
a visa to study in Japan.  
2) The Immigration Bureau in Tokyo issues the COE and sends it to Science Tokyo.  
3) The staff of Science Tokyo send the scanned copy of COE to a student.  
4) Student prints out both sides of the COE and bring it to the Japanese  
Embassy/Consulate-General in his/her country to apply for your student visa.

Språkkrav.md:
For bachelor courses:

No language test needed, but English language proficiency level C1 is expected.

For Master courses:

An official Proof of English language proficiency C1 is required according to VU Amsterdam’s requirements.

Exempted are students who are enrolled in a completely English-taught Master’s degree.

Engineering students or students who has not yet started an international master programme need to do an English test if they want to take master level courses. (TOEFL IBT at least 110, acacdemid IELTS 7.5)

Om universitetet.md:
Established in 1855 as the Federal Polytechnic School, ETH Zurich has, from the outset, been a national centre for education with international appeal, attracting talent from all over the world.

ETH Zurich was given its present name, Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule), in 1911. Over the decades that followed, it entered into solid partnerships with the state and with industry and invested increasingly in both applied and fundamental research, which were gaining in importance in relation to education. The university grew steadily and in 1961 it embarked on the first stage of constructing its second site on the Hönggerberg, on the outskirts of Zurich.

The long- standing tradition of ETH Zurich, combined with its ability constantly to adapt to new requirements, have brought great success to the university. Today, it ranks among the world’s leading universities of science and technology.
